Guidance & outlook: On the supply side, manufacturing is estimated to grow by 7.0% in FY 2025-26, compared with 4.5% in FY 2024-25, while services are estimated to grow by 9.1%.
Outlook for FY 2026-27 The outlook for FY 2026-27 remains cautiously positive.
The EBITDA margin stood at 76.69% for FY 2025-26 compared to 82.19% in FY 2024-25.
Growth & demand: As per the Economic Survey 2025-26, India's real GDP growth for FY 2025-26 is estimated at 7.4%, with GVA growth estimated at 7.3%, reaffirming India's position among the fastest-growing major economies.

On the demand side, private final consumption expenditure is estimated to grow by 7.0%, while gross fixed capital formation is estimated to expand by 7.8%, indicating continued support from domestic consumption and investment.

The Economic Survey 2025-26 has projected India's real GDP growth in the range of 6.8% to 7.2% for FY 2026-27, supported by resilient domestic demand, investment, infrastructure development, manufacturing expansion and the continued strength of the services sector.
